say:1:1910710002:1.text: 你抬起头，面前初具人形的肉块静静悬浮在温暖的水中，没有呼吸，没有心跳，然而生命的力量却在眼前的东西中流转 。

say:2:1910710003:1.text: It's so familiar to you. You feel like you know it as well as you know yourself...
say:2:1910710003:1.source_cn: 你对它太熟悉了，你了解它，如同了解自己——
say:2:1910710003:1.male: It's so familiar to you. You feel like you know it as well as you know yourself...
say:2:1910710003:1.female: It's so familiar to you. You feel like you know it as well as you know yourself...

say:3:1910710004:1.text: Fear strikes you all at once, as if you had glimpsed your own face in that formless thing of flesh. No, it's an illusion! You spit out a flurry of bubbles and turn to flee.

say:4:1910710005:1.text: All around you, countless human-shaped things press in upon your field of vision... Some whole, some maimed, some nothing but a single face set into the wall of flesh...

say:5:1910710006:1.text: They're suspended in a soft and holy radiance... unborn, unliving, not yet dead... They resemble unfinished statues forgotten in the workshop of a god.

say:8:1910710008:1.text: 没有任何回应，四周寂静无声，唯有你的心跳动着。战栗、激动、未知和恐惧——你竟然开始不自觉地颤抖。

choice:7:0:1.text: What in the world is this?!
choice:7:0:1.source_cn: 这是什么，这到底是什么？！
choice:7:0:1.male: What in the world is this?!
choice:7:0:1.female: What in the world is this?!

choice:7:2:3.text: Tolan, I'm here! Can you hear me?!
choice:7:2:3.source_cn: 图澜，我在这里！听见了吗？！
